extracted.intended_audience: PARI/GP users and developers working with relative number fields and central simple algebras (computational number theorists)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference and behavioral specification for PARI/GP functions operating on relative number field (rnf) objects and central simple algebras, including input/output formats, flags, warnings, and computational caveats. Covers ideal operations, norm/prime decomposition, polynomial reduction, pseudobases, and algebra API functions.

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealabstorel
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf (L/K) and x an ideal of the absolute extension L/Q, return the relative pseudo-matrix in HNF giving x considered as an ideal of the relative extension L/K (i.e. as a Z_K-module).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: x may be supplied in any format attached to the attached absolute nf (Labs) such as a prime ideal or an ideal in HNF wrt Labs.zk. If Labs is unavailable, a Z-basis for x may be given instead; entries of x may be given modulo rnf.polabs (absolute form) or modulo rnf.pol (relative polmods). Examples show conversion to/from relative/absolute forms. Library syntax: GEN rnfidealabstorel(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealdown
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf (L/K) and x an ideal of L (relative form or Z-basis), return the ideal of K below x (intersection x ∩ K).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Straightforward downward ideal map. Library syntax: GEN rnfidealdown(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealfactor
rubrics_metrics.description: Factor the ideal x in the attached absolute number field L into prime ideal powers. Prime ideals are represented as by idealprimedec for L.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Output format is similar to factor; note that ideals of the base field K must be explicitly lifted to L via rnfidealup before they can be factored. Library syntax: GEN rnfidealfactor(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealhnf
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf (L/K) and x a relative ideal (many input types allowed, including elements), compute the HNF pseudo-matrix attached to x viewed as a Z_K-module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Works for the same range of relative input types as in the absolute-case idealhnf. Library syntax: GEN rnfidealhnf(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealmul
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf (L/K) and x,y ideals of the relative extension L/K given by pseudo-matrices, return the product ideal x*y as a relative ideal (pseudo-matrix).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Input and output are in relative pseudo-matrix (ZK-module) form. Library syntax: GEN rnfidealmul(GEN rnf, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealnormabs
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute the norm of a relative ideal x considered as an ideal of the absolute extension L/Q (absolute norm).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is identical to idealnorm(rnf, rnfidealnormrel(rnf,x)) but faster. Library syntax: GEN rnfidealnormabs(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealnormrel
rubrics_metrics.description: Compute the relative norm of a relative ideal x as an ideal of K, returned in HNF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns the relative norm as a HNF ideal of K. Library syntax: GEN rnfidealnormrel(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealprimedec
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf (L/K) and pr a maximal ideal of K (prid) or a rational prime p, compute the prime ideal decomposition of pr in L/K (completing rnf with an absolute nf structure if needed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If argument is a prime number p, returns [SK, SL] where SK contains primes of K above p and SL[i] lists primes of L above SK[i]. Note: function may complete rnf with nf structure (costly). Library syntax: GEN rnfidealprimedec(GEN rnf, GEN pr).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealreltoabs
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf and x a relative ideal (pseudo-matrix [A,I]), return x as an absolute ideal of L/Q. flag controls output form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: flag = 0 (default): return vector of t_POLMODs modulo rnf.pol forming a Z-basis (cheap). flag = 1: return HNF in terms of a fixed Z-basis for ZL (requires completing rnf with absolute nf structure; expensive). Default avoids completing rnf to save cost; setting flag=1 will complete rnf. Library syntax: GEN rnfidealreltoabs0(GEN rnf, GEN x, long flag) and GEN rnfidealreltoabs(GEN rnf, GEN x) (flag=0).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealtwoelt
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf and x a relative ideal (pseudo-matrix), return a vector of two generators of x over ZL expressed as polmods with polmod coefficients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides two-element generating set for ideal as ZL-module. Library syntax: GEN rnfidealtwoelement(GEN rnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfidealup
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf (L/K) and x an ideal of K, return the ideal x*Z_L as an absolute ideal of L/Q in the form of a Z-basis. flag controls output form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: flag = 0 (default): result given by vector of polynomials modulo rnf.pol (cheap). flag = 1: return HNF in terms of fixed Z-basis for ZL (completes rnf and is expensive). Reason: rnf does not contain a fixed Z-basis for ZL by default to avoid costly completion. Library syntax: GEN rnfidealup0(GEN rnf, GEN x, long flag) and GEN rnfidealup(GEN rnf, GEN x) (flag=0).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfinit
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an nf structure for K and a monic irreducible polynomial T in K[x] (main variable priority rules apply), compute the rnf structure for L = K[x]/(T) including technical data to work in L/K. flag controls whether to add an nf structure for L.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Result is a row vector with components rnf[1]..rnf[12] storing pol, integer bases, relative discriminant, index, pseudo-basis for ZL as ZK-module (rnf.zk), inverse integral basis matrix, embedded absolute equation data (rnf.polabs etc.), and optional attached nf structure when flag=1. flag=1 computes an absolute nf for L (fixes integer basis and allows absolute input/output forms) but can be very expensive when absolute degree is large. Special input [T,B] accepted to handle huge discriminants by computing an order maximal at primes < B (faster and sometimes sufficient). Caveat about generator mismatch (k != 0) and suggested remedy using rnfequation/subst. Library syntax: GEN rnfinit0(GEN nf, GEN T, long flag) and GEN rnfinit(GEN nf, GEN T) (flag=0).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfisabelian
rubrics_metrics.description: Given an nf and a relative polynomial T, return 1 if T defines an abelian extension, 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple boolean test. Library syntax: long rnfisabelian(GEN nf, GEN T).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfisfree
rubrics_metrics.description: Given bnf (from bnfinit) and either a polynomial or pseudo-basis defining a relative extension L of bnf, return 1 if L/bnf is free (i.e., free as module), 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Boolean test for freeness of the extension as a module over the base. Library syntax: long rnfisfree(GEN bnf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfislocalcyclo
rubrics_metrics.description: Given rnf (L/K) of degree a power of a prime p, return 1 if the extension is locally cyclotomic (contained in cyclotomic Z_p-extension at all places dividing p), 0 otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for detecting local cyclotomic behavior; demonstrates p-adic continuity phenomena. Library syntax: long rnfislocalcyclo(GEN rnf).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfisnorm
rubrics_metrics.description: Given data T produced by rnfisnorminit and an element a in K, try to decide whether a is the norm of some x in L/K and find x (S-integer solution). Returns vector [x,q] with a = Norm(x)*q.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Algorithm searches for S-integer solutions where S contains ramified primes, generators of class group of L, and primes dividing a. If L/K is Galois the answer is guaranteed (q=1 iff a is a norm). Otherwise, guarantee under GRH if S contains all primes below 12 log2 |disc(M)| where M is normal closure. flag parameter extends S by adding primes p ≤ flag (or p|flag if flag < 0). If rnfisnorminit determined L/K is Galois and flag=0, a Warning is issued. Library syntax: GEN rnfisnorm(GEN T, GEN a, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfisnorminit
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare technical data for solving norm equations N_{L/K}(x)=a: given pol for K and polrel for L/K, compute data used by rnfisnorm; flag controls Galois assumptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: flag=0: don't assume Galois; flag=1: assume L/K is Galois (unchecked, speeds up rnfisnorm); flag=2: let the routine determine whether L/K is Galois. Library syntax: GEN rnfisnorminit(GEN pol, GEN polrel, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfkummer
rubrics_metrics.description: Given bnr (output of bnrinit) and optional subgroup and degree d, find a relative equation for the class field corresponding to the module in bnr and the given congruence subgroup (full ray class field if subgroup omitted). If d>0 output all relative equations of degree d with same conductor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Warning: routine only works for subgroups of prime index and uses Kummer theory (requires adjoining roots of unity and heavy bnfinit). For composite-degree extensions, user must split extension manually as tower/compositum of prime-degree extensions. Library syntax: GEN rnfkummer(GEN bnr, GEN subgp = NULL, long d, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnflllgram
rubrics_metrics.description: Given nf, a relative polynomial pol defining L and a suborder 'order' of maximal rank (e.g., from rnfpseudobasis or rnfpseudobasis-like), returns [[neworder], U] where neworder is a reduced order and U is the unimodular transformation matrix (LLL-style reduction over number fields).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefix and parameter 'prec' supported. Library syntax: GEN rnflllgram(GEN nf, GEN pol, GEN order, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfnormgroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Given bnr (big ray class field) and pol (relative polynomial defining an Abelian extension), compute the norm group (Artin/Takagi group) corresponding to the Abelian subextension of bnr defined by pol; result is HNF defining norm group on given generators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assumes pol defines Abelian extension and bnr.module is a multiple of the conductor; these assumptions are NOT checked. If assumption fails, function returns empty matrix or may return wrong result. Library syntax: GEN rnfnormgroup(GEN bnr, GEN pol).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfpolred (obsolete)
rubrics_metrics.description: Relative version of polred (obsolete); given monic polynomial pol with coefficients in nf, finds list of relative polynomials defining some subfields, hopefully simpler and containing original field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marked obsolete; use rnfpolredbest instead. Based on incomplete lattice reduction over number fields (rnflllgram) and slower than rnfpolredbest. Library syntax: GEN rnfpolred(GEN nf, GEN pol, long prec).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfpolredabs
rubrics_metrics.description: Relative version of polredabs: given irreducible monic pol with coefficients in nf, find a canonical relative polynomial defining same field with small coefficients. Binary flag bits control output form and behavior.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag bits: 1 add info to convert elements to new representation (return [P,a]); 2 return absolute polynomial Pabs instead of relative (canonical and independent of nf); 3 return [Pabs, a, b] where Pabs is absolute and a,b roots; 16 possibly use a suborder of maximal order (affects canonicity). Warning: complexity exponential in absolute degree; prefer rnfpolredbest which runs in polynomial time and often returns smaller discriminants. Library syntax: GEN rnfpolredabs(GEN nf, GEN pol, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfpolredbest
rubrics_metrics.description: Relative version of polredbest: given monic polynomial pol with coefficients in nf, find a simpler relative polynomial P defining same field; polynomial-time heuristic that tends to produce small-coefficient polynomials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag bits as in rnfpolredabs: 0 default return P; 1 return [P,a]; 2 return Pabs; 3 return [Pabs,a,b]. Provides examples illustrating relative->absolute conversions. Library syntax: GEN rnfpolredbest(GEN nf, GEN pol, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfpseudobasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Given nf and T defining relative extension L, compute the relative discriminant of L and a pseudo-basis (A,J) for maximal order ZL viewed as ZK-module; output [A,J,D,d] where D is relative ideal discriminant and d is relative discriminant in K*/K*^2.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accepts input [T,B] to produce an order maximal at primes < B (useful for huge discriminants). Example demonstrates that using [T,B] can be much faster while producing identical results if discriminant factors are small. Library syntax: GEN rnfpseudobasis(GEN nf, GEN T).

rubrics_metrics.name: rnfsteinitz
rubrics_metrics.description: Given nf and either polynomial or pseudo-basis defining a relative extension L, compute another pseudo-basis (A,I) (not necessarily HNF) such that all ideals of I except perhaps the last equal ZK; output [A,I,D,d]. The Steinitz class is the ideal class of the last ideal of I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns a pseudo-basis suitable for reading off the Steinitz class of ZL as ZK-module. Library syntax: GEN rnfsteinitz(GEN nf, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: subgrouplist
rubrics_metrics.description: Given bnr (or list of cyclic components of a finite Abelian group G), output list of subgroups of G represented as HNF left divisors of SNF matrix of G. Optional bound and flag modify output.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If flag=0 (default) and bnr is from bnrinit, gives only subgroups whose modulus is the conductor; otherwise modulus ignored. If bound is positive integer restrict to index < bound; if bound = [B] restrict to index exactly B. Examples show enumerating subgroups and extracting subfields via galoissubcyclo or bnrstark/rnfkummer. Library syntax: GEN subgrouplist0(GEN bnr, GEN bound = NULL, long flag).

rubrics_metrics.name: Central/simple algebra definitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Definitions: finite-dimensional unital associative algebra A over field K; central if center is K; simple if no nontrivial two-sided ideals; semisimple if Jacobson radical is trivial; CSA over K has dimension d^2 and degree d; index is degree of central division algebra factor.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cyclic algebra construction: (L/K, σ, b) with L/K cyclic degree d, relation x^d = b and x*λ = σ(λ)*x. Hasse invariant for local fields described (h/d in Q/Z). These conceptual definitions set expected algebra representations and invariants used by API.

rubrics_metrics.name: Orders in algebras (natural order)
rubrics_metrics.description: Order in algebra A (finite-dim over Q) is finitely generated Z-submodule O with QO = A and subring with 1. For cyclic algebra (L/K,σ,b) with b integral, natural order is sum x^i Z_L; for multiplication-table-defined CSA over K natural order is sum Z_K * basis elements (assuming integral multiplication table).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: alginit by default computes a Z-basis of a maximal order O0 (or natural order if maximal not computed). Natural basis construction described explicitly in terms of bases of ZL or ZK and algebra basis elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lattices in algebras (representation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Full lattice J ⊂ A is represented as two-component t_VEC [I,t] with I an integral nonsingular upper-triangular matrix representing sublattice of O0 expressed on integral basis and t ∈ Q>0 a t_INT or t_FRAC, so J = t * I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For efficiency use primitive matrices in HNF for uniqueness; all GP functions return lattices in this canonical form. Prefix for lattice functions is alglat.

rubrics_metrics.name: GP conventions for algebra element representations
rubrics_metrics.description: Two representations: algebraic representation and basis representation. In central simple algebra object al, a Z-basis of an order O0 is stored; basis representation is t_COL with coefficients in Q expressing element in that basis; algebraic representation is t_COL with coefficients in L (for cyclic algebra decomposition) or in K (for multiplication-table algebra).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conversion functions algalgtobasis and algbasistoalg exist. Warning: coefficients in decomposition A = sum x^i L are not same as coefficients in sum L x^i; i-th coefficients are related by conjugation by x^i (acting by σ^i). Also for CSA over Q defined by multiplication table, GP cannot distinguish representation from vector size: coerce to basis rep if coefficients are t_INT/t_FRAC, algebraic rep if t_POL/t_POLMOD.

rubrics_metrics.name: algadd
rubrics_metrics.description: Given algebra al and two elements x,y in al, compute their sum x+y. Also accepts matrices with coefficients in al.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Basic addition operation with example. Library syntax: GEN algadd(GEN al, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: algalgtobasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Convert an element x in central simple algebra al (algebraic representation) to a column vector on the integral basis of al (basis representation). Inverse of algbasistoalg.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example provided; useful for moving between algebraic and basis representations. Library syntax: GEN algalgtobasis(GEN al, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: algaut
rubrics_metrics.description: Given cyclic algebra al = (L/K,σ,b) output by alginit, return the automorphism σ (as an element acting on L).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns σ as element/expression. Library syntax: GEN algaut(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algb
rubrics_metrics.description: Given cyclic algebra al = (L/K, σ, b) output by alginit, return the scalar b ∈ K used in the cyclic algebra definition (x^d = b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows returned element in nf. Library syntax: GEN algb(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algbasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Given a central simple algebra al output by alginit, return a Z-basis of the order O0 stored in al with respect to the natural order in al (maximal order if computed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Return is a matrix whose columns/rows give basis elements in integral coordinates. Library syntax: GEN algbasis(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algbasistoalg
rubrics_metrics.description: Convert an element x in algebra al from basis representation (t_COL on integral basis) to algebraic representation. Inverse of algalgtobasis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows conversion and liftall to display algebraic components. Library syntax: GEN algbasistoalg(GEN al, GEN x).

rubrics_metrics.name: algcenter
rubrics_metrics.description: If al is table algebra (algtableinit) return basis of center over prime field (Q or Fp); if al is CSA (alginit) return center of al (stored in al).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For table algebras returns basis vectors; for CSA returns nf describing center (pol). Library syntax: GEN algcenter(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algcentralproj
rubrics_metrics.description: Given table algebra al and vector z of orthogonal central idempotents, return vector [al1,..,aln] of algebras ali = zi * al. If maps=1 also return [quo, proj, lift] for each component.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to decompose algebra according to central idempotents. Examples given. Library syntax: GEN alg_centralproj(GEN al, GEN z, long maps).

rubrics_metrics.name: algchar
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the characteristic (prime field characteristic) of algebra al (table algebra or CSA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Simple integer return (e.g., 0 for Q). Library syntax: GEN algchar(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algcharpoly
rubrics_metrics.description: Given algebra al and element b, return its characteristic polynomial in variable v. If al is table algebra or abs=1 return absolute characteristic polynomial (Fp[v] or Q[v]); if al is CSA and abs=0 return reduced characteristic polynomial in center K[v].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also accepts square matrices with coefficients in al. Parameter v is optional variable number. Examples illustrate reduced vs absolute polynomials. Library syntax: GEN algcharpoly(GEN al, GEN b, long v = -1, long abs).

rubrics_metrics.name: algdegree
rubrics_metrics.description: Given CSA al, return the degree of al (d such that dim_K A = d^2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integer degree of central simple algebra. Library syntax: long algdegree(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algdim
rubrics_metrics.description: If al is table algebra or abs=1, return dimension of al over its prime subfield (Q or Fp); if al is CSA and abs=0 return dimension of al over its center.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two-argument form algdim(al, abs). Examples show difference between dimension over center vs over Q. Library syntax: long algdim(GEN al, long abs).

rubrics_metrics.name: algdisc
rubrics_metrics.description: Given CSA al output by alginit, compute discriminant of stored order O0, defined as determinant of trace form Tr: O0×O0 → Z.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example shows computation and relation to local Hasse data. Library syntax: GEN algdisc(GEN al).

rubrics_metrics.name: algdivl
rubrics_metrics.description: Given algebra al and elements x,y, compute left quotient x\y (z such that x*z = y); assumes left divisibility holds. If x invertible this is x^{-1}y. Accepts matrices with coefficients in al.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If x is zero divisor solutions are not unique; routine returns some z. Library syntax: GEN algdivl(GEN al, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: algdivr
rubrics_metrics.description: Given algebra al and elements x,y, compute right quotient x*y^{-1} (assuming invertibility); accepts matrices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides division on right. Library syntax: GEN algdivr(GEN al, GEN x, GEN y).

rubrics_metrics.name: alggroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Initialize group algebra K[G] over K=Q (p omitted) or Fp where G is group underlying galoisinit structure gal or a t_VEC of permutations closed under products. Returns alg object.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example constructs algebra from galoisinit or explicit permutation group. Use to study semisimplicity via algissemisimple. Library syntax: GEN alggroup(GEN gal, GEN p = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: alggroupcenter
rubrics_metrics.description: Initialize the center Z(K[G]) of group algebra K[G] over K (Q or Fp) where G is given by galoisinit or permutation list. Also sets cc = [elts, conjclass, rep, flag] describing element/conjugacy class structure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: cc provides sorted list of group elements, conjugacy class indices, representatives, and transitivity flag. Basis of center consists of indicator functions of conjugacy classes in ordering given by cc. Library syntax: GEN alggroupcenter(GEN gal, GEN p = NULL, GEN *cc = NULL).

rubrics_metrics.name: alghasse
rubrics_metrics.description: Given CSA al and a prime ideal or archimedean place index, return t_FRAC h the local Hasse invariant of al at specified place pl.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Returns invariants like 1/2 or 0 in examples. Library syntax: GEN alghasse(GEN al, GEN pl).
